info.name: Bharat Provider — Scheme Document Search (Beckn)
info.description:
Postman collection for testing Scheme Document Search migrated to Beckn Provider.

## Main API

**POST** `{{baseUrl}}/mobility/search`

Route is selected by `message.intent.category.descriptor.code` (or `.name`):

| Category code | Backend | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `scheme-agri-qdrant` | Qdrant vector search | Document chunks from scheme guidelines (NEW) |
| `schemes-agri` | Hasura | Structured scheme catalog (unchanged) |

## Query fields (scheme-agri-qdrant)

- **Query text**: `message.intent.item.descriptor.name` (required), or tags `search_params.query`
- **Scheme hint (optional)**: `message.intent.item.descriptor.code` or tags `scheme_code`
- **top_k (optional, 1–20)**: tags `top_k` (default 10)

## Indexed scheme codes

`cdp`, `cotton-mission`, `e-nam`, `makhana`, `midh`, `mif`, `nbm`, `nmeo`, `pkvy`, `pm-ddky`, `pm-kmy`, `pm-rkvy`, `pulses-mission`, `rwbcis`

## Prerequisites

1. Provider running (`npm run start:dev`) — default port **3000**
2. For Qdrant path: `QDRANT_URL` + `EMBEDDING_SERVICE_URL` configured in `.env`

## How to import

Postman → Import → select this file → set `baseUrl` collection variable if needed.

Vector document search via Qdrant. Does **not** use Hasura.

item.name: 1. Search by natural language query (auto scheme resolve)

request.description:
## Primary API to test Qdrant scheme document search

**POST** `{{baseUrl}}/mobility/search`

### Routing
Category `scheme-agri-qdrant` routes to `SchemeQdrantService.search()`.

### Request
- Query is taken from `message.intent.item.descriptor.name`
- Search is unfiltered semantic search over all scheme chunks; each chunk carries its own scheme code/name

### Success response shape
```json
{
  "context": { "action": "on_search", ... },
  "message": {
    "catalog": {
      "descriptor": { "code": "scheme-agri-qdrant", "name": "Scheme Document Search" },
      "tags": [{ "list": [ /* query, status, hit-count, resolved-scheme-code */ ] }],
      "providers": [{
        "id": "scheme-documents",
        "items": [{ "id": "...", "descriptor": { "long_desc": "chunk text" }, "tags": [...] }]
      }]
    }
  }
}
```

### Status values (in catalog tags)
- `success` — hits returned
- `not_found` — no chunk answers the query
- `failed` — missing query
- `error` — Qdrant/embedding misconfigured or runtime failure

Explicit scheme hint via `item.descriptor.code = "pkvy"`.

Query still comes from `item.descriptor.name`.

item.name: 3. Search via search_params tags (query + scheme_code + top_k)

request.description:
Uses tag group `search_params`:
- `query` / `search_value` — search text (used if descriptor.name is empty)
- `scheme_code` / `scheme-code` — scheme filter
- `top_k` / `topk` — result limit (clamped 1–20)
Intent classification should pick up *application* focus and may run supplemental search.
Negative test: empty query → catalog status `failed` with message about missing search query. Still HTTP 200 with Beckn envelope.
